item.title: Mary Scanlon (née Counihan)
item.description: Mary Scanlon (née Counihan) of Annagh, Tralee and late of Curraheen, passed away suddenly but peacefully on the 10th of February 2026 surrounded by her loving family. Beloved wife of the late Eddie Scanlon, sadly missed by her daughters Anne-Maria, Rosalie, son-in-law, Micheál Sheehan, adored grandsons Darragh and Éanna, brothers and sisters, Tim (Teddy), Liz, Cathy Mai, William, brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law, nieces, nephews, relatives and many friends. Eternal rest grant onto her, O Lord.

item.title: Plans submitted to build 57 homes in Rathmore
item.description: Plans have been submitted to build 57 homes in Rathmore. Old Road Limited Partnership has made the application to Kerry County Council. Fianna Fáil councillor Niall Kelleher is one of the general partners in this partnership. Advertisement The plans include 26 two-storey houses and 10 one-bedroom apartments, south of Main Street, Rathmore. Advertisement

item.title: 40% drop in number of Gardaí in the Kerry Roads Policing Unit over 17 years
item.description: There has been a 40% drop in the number of Gardaí in the Kerry Roads Policing Unit over 17 years. That’s according to figures compiled by Parc Road Safety Group, published by An Garda Síochána. According to the Irish Examiner, as of December 2025 there were 21 gardaí assigned to the RPU in Kerry. Advertisement This is a reduction of 14 when compared with 2009, when 35 members were assigned to the unit in the county. item.title: Dublin man admits to possession of stolen guns and ammo in Kerry
item.description: A Dublin man has admitted to the possession of stolen guns and ammunition in Kerry last year. 20-year-old Gerry Wall, of Greenhills Grove, Tallaght, entered guilty pleas to four counts on arraignment at Tralee Circuit Court. Mr Wall and his co-accused are both due to be sentenced on 6th March. Advertisement Gerry Wall pleaded guilty to four charges at Tralee Circuit Court. item.title: Minister for Mental Health has now received long-awaited North Kerry CAMHS report
item.description: The Minister for Mental Health has confirmed she has received the long-awaited report on North Kerry CAMHS. A lookback review into all files in North Kerry CAMHS was commissioned in 2023 after a sample audit of random open cases raised concerns. There has been criticism of the length of time it took to conduct the North Kerry CAMHS review, and compile the report. item.title: Ireland name side to face Italy
item.description: Ireland under-20s head coach Andrew Browne has named his team for Friday's hosting of Italy in the Six Nations. There are three changes to the team that suffered a 50-21 defeat to France in Perpignan last Saturday. Lee Fitzpatrick, Joe Finn, and Rob Carney all come into the side for the game in Cork. item.title: Robbie Keane happy at Ferencvaros, desipite Tottenham links
item.description: Robbie Keane insists he's content where he is, despite being linked with the vacant manager's job at Tottenham. The former Ireland and Spurs captain is currently in charge at Ferencvaros, who lead the Hungarian top-flight. Tottenham, who are 16th in the Premier League, sacked manager Thomas Frank after last night's defeat to Newcastle. Advertisement
